districtFact: Weber's one-page calendar combines a daily A/B rotation with an early-out schedule every Wednesday. Opening week and several quarter-ending dates add other early-out days, while elementary and secondary parent-teacher conferences use separate dates and dismissal rules.

about.title: Wednesday Early Out Has Two Bell Times
about.content: Every instructional Wednesday is early out. The elementary time remains 12:20 in both reviewed years, while the secondary time changes from 1:20 in 2025-2026 to 1:15 in 2026-2027. Families should not carry one year's secondary time into the next.

about.title: Opening Week Uses an Expanded Early-Out Schedule
about.content: The first student day is early out, and the remaining instructional days of opening week are also listed as early out. This creates a full shortened opening week rather than a single first-day exception.

about.title: A/B Letters Are Instructional Markers
about.content: The date grid prints A or B on instructional days. Those letters describe the secondary class rotation; they are not closure labels. The one-time MySchoolDates download therefore does not create a separate event for every A or B day.

about.title: Conference Dates Depend on School Level
about.content: Elementary parent-teacher conference dates use published early-out instructions, while secondary conferences occur on different dates. Compensation days are separate no-school dates and should not be inferred from the conference date alone.

about.title: The Calendar Accounts for 180 Days
about.content: Both reviewed PDFs divide the year into four quarters totaling 180 days. The quarter lengths shift from 47/44/49/40 in 2025-2026 to 43/43/49/45 in 2026-2027, so families should use the relevant year's quarter boundaries.

planningTips.title: Weber School District Calendar Notes
content: Use the A/B letter in the official PDF with the student's secondary timetable; the letters are not repeated in the ICS file.
Plan for early out every instructional Wednesday: elementary dismissal is 12:20, while the published secondary time is year-specific.
Treat the first student week as an early-out week, not only the first day.
Check whether a parent-teacher conference is elementary or secondary before changing transportation or child-care plans.
Compensation and professional-development days are no-student days even when they sit next to a break or conference date.
High school ACT day and the elementary Iron Kid/Math Olympiad dates are program markers, not districtwide closures.
The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and will not update automatically if WSD revises its calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Are Wednesdays early-out days in Weber School District?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Both reviewed district PDFs say every instructional Wednesday is early out. Elementary dismissal is 12:20; secondary dismissal is 1:20 in 2025-2026 and 1:15 in 2026-2027.

districtFaqs.q: What do A and B mean on the Weber calendar?
districtFaqs.a: A and B identify the alternating secondary class schedule on instructional days. They do not indicate a closure or an early-out day.

districtFaqs.q: Is the first week of school early out in Weber?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The first student day and the remaining instructional days of opening week are listed as early-out days in both reviewed years.

districtFaqs.q: Do elementary and secondary schools use the same conference dates?
districtFaqs.a: No. The official calendars list separate elementary and secondary parent-teacher conference dates. Elementary dates also carry specific early-out instructions.

districtFaqs.q: How many school days are on the Weber calendar?
districtFaqs.a: The four published quarter counts total 180 days in both 2025-2026 and 2026-2027.
